legal.notice: RiskLex is informational and does not replace advice from a lawyer.

consent.title: Before analyzing
consent.what: To analyze it, RiskLex will send the text of the document you pasted to the RiskLex backend, which passes it to its artificial intelligence provider.
consent.retention: The artificial intelligence provider may keep the data temporarily: up to 30 days, or longer if some content is flagged for review. RiskLex does not store the document or the result.
consent.advice: Do not paste information you do not want to share, such as passwords or health data.
consent.session: We will ask you again the next time you open RiskLex.

input.label: Document text
input.hint: Paste the terms and conditions or the privacy policy here.
input.tooLong: The text is longer than the {{max}} character limit. Shorten the document and try again.

steps.waiting_for_analysis: Analyzing with artificial intelligence. It can take up to two minutes.
steps.verifying_quotes: Checking that every quote appears in your document
steps.retrying: Repeating the analysis to verify more quotes

analyze.title: What are you about to accept today?
analyze.lead: Paste the text of the terms or the privacy policy. We tell you, in plain words, what could happen if you accept.
analyze.emptyHint: Paste the document text to analyze it.

sample.label: Use sample text
sample.note: It is a fictional document, written to try RiskLex.

sources.label: How to add the document
sources.linkNotice: RiskLex will download this page from your computer, so the site will see your IP address. Nothing is sent to the AI until you press Analyze.

invalid_request.message: We could not read the text you sent.
invalid_request.next: Check that you pasted the whole document and try again.

document_too_large.message: The document is too long to analyze at once.
document_too_large.next: Shorten it below {{max}} characters and try again.

rate_limited.message: Too many analyses were made in a row.
rate_limited.next: Wait a minute and try again.

provider_error.message: The artificial intelligence service did not respond properly.
provider_error.next: Try again in a few minutes.

provider_refusal.message: The artificial intelligence service declined to analyze this text.
provider_refusal.next: Check that it is a terms or privacy document and try again.

output_truncated.message: The analysis was incomplete because the document is very long.
output_truncated.next: Try a shorter part of the document.

network_unavailable.message: We could not connect to RiskLex.
network_unavailable.next: Check your internet connection and try again.

timeout.next: Try again. If it happens again, try a shorter document.

cancelled.next: You can analyze the document again whenever you want.

invalid_response.message: We received a response we could not understand.
invalid_response.next: Try again in a few minutes.

low_reliability.message: We could not confirm any quote of the analysis in your document, so we are not showing it.
low_reliability.next: Check that the text is complete and try again.

configuration_missing.message: The RiskLex server address is not configured.
configuration_missing.next: If you develop the app, follow the README instructions and open RiskLex again.

analysis_in_progress.next: Wait for it to finish or cancel it before starting another one.

unexpected.next: Try again. If it happens again, close and reopen RiskLex.

results.essentialsEmpty: We found nothing that needs special attention for this profile.

card.insufficientEvidence: The text is not enough to reach a firm conclusion.

profiles.legend: How do you use this service?

results.title: Analysis results

clauses.title: Review each point
clauses.empty: There are no points in this category.
clauses.none: We found no relevant clauses in this document.

notices.lowReliability: Many quotes of the analysis did not appear in your document, so this result is less reliable than usual. Review the remaining points more carefully and compare them with the original text.
notices.truncated: The document has more relevant points than we show here. This analysis is not complete: read the original document too.
notices.fixture: Test result, not a real analysis.
notices.discarded: We removed {{discarded}} of {{total}} points because we could not confirm their original text in your document.

pdf_not_pdf.message: This file is not a PDF.
pdf_not_pdf.next: Choose a PDF file or paste the text.

pdf_too_large.message: The PDF is larger than the {{maxMb}} MB limit.
pdf_too_large.next: Use a smaller PDF or paste only the terms.

pdf_too_many_pages.message: The PDF has more than {{maxPages}} pages.
pdf_too_many_pages.next: Use a shorter PDF or paste only the terms.

pdf_encrypted.message: This PDF is protected with a password.
pdf_encrypted.next: Open it in your PDF reader, copy the text and paste it here.

pdf_damaged.message: We could not read this PDF: it looks damaged or incomplete.
pdf_damaged.next: Download it again or paste the text.

pdf_no_text.message: This PDF looks like a scanned image: it has no text we can read.
pdf_no_text.next: Look for a version of the document with text or copy and paste the text.

pdf_timeout.message: Reading this PDF takes too much time or memory.
pdf_timeout.next: Try another file or paste the text.

document_too_long.message: The document has {{characters}} characters and the limit is {{max}}.
document_too_long.next: Paste only the terms or the privacy part.

document_cancelled.next: The text in the box has not changed.

document_unexpected.message: Something went wrong while reading the document.
document_unexpected.next: Try again or paste the text.

link_invalid.next: Check that it is a full web address, for example https://example.com/terms.

link_blocked.message: For safety, RiskLex does not read addresses on private or local networks.
link_blocked.next: Use the public address of the page or paste the text.

link_unreachable.message: We could not connect to that page.
link_unreachable.next: Check your connection and the address, or paste the text.

link_timeout.message: The page took too long to respond.
link_timeout.next: Try again later or paste the text.

link_too_many_redirects.message: The page redirects too many times.
link_too_many_redirects.next: Open it in your browser, copy the text and paste it here.

link_http_error.message: The page answered with an error.
link_http_error.next: Check that the address is right or paste the text.

link_unsupported_type.message: That address is neither a web page nor a PDF.
link_unsupported_type.next: Use the link to the terms page or paste the text.

link_too_large.message: The page is too large to read.
link_too_large.next: Paste only the terms or the privacy part.

link_no_text.message: We found no text on this page.
link_no_text.next: Open it in your browser, copy the text and paste it here.

link_needs_javascript.message: This page needs JavaScript to show its text.
link_needs_javascript.next: Open it in your browser, copy the text and paste it here.

link_forbidden.message: The page does not let RiskLex read it.
link_forbidden.next: Open it in your browser, copy the text and paste it here.

link_not_found.message: We could not find that page.
link_not_found.next: Check the address or look for the updated link to the terms.

link_rate_limited.message: The page received too many requests.
link_rate_limited.next: Wait a few minutes and try again, or paste the text.

link_server_error.message: The site had a problem answering.
link_server_error.next: Try again later or paste the text.
